flexibleFocus.label: Flexible
flexibleFocus.note: Pseudo-focus used by days/blocks that are intentionally unassigned; not a category. Its share (weights.flexibleShare) is the waking window the categories did not claim: rest days, seasonal and occasional work, catching up, and time kept open.
